itens.trecho: Português A História não passou por aqui. Este filme conta a história de William Wallace (Mel Gibson), um paladino da independência escocesa que exortou os Escoceses a lutar contra as tentativas de invasão dos ingleses. Dirigido por Mel Gibson (que também desempenha o papel principal), o roteiro é de Randall Wallace.

Historical flaws aside, Braveheart is a rousing spectacle. So it comes to pass in the year of 1995 (not a year of our lord I think) that Mel Gibson would craft the award winning epic that is Braveheart, a film that is historically bent in the extreme, that is directed by a man who would go on to have a less than favourable character reputation, and a film…

I am afraid that as a Scotsman, I had way more problem with the factual elements of this than perhaps I ought to have had. We have this history drummed into us as bairns, and so when a grand-scale depiction like this comes along, I excitedly expected more.
